# asyntai_instructions (Resource)

The AI instructions of one website: the rules the AI agent follows when it answers. Terraform owns the whole text. Each change keeps the previous text in the instruction history of the dashboard.

~> `terraform destroy` removes this resource from the Terraform state only. The instructions stay on the website, because an agent without instructions cannot answer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asyntai_instructions" "shop" {
  website_id    = asyntai_website.shop.id
  ask_questions = true

  instructions = <<-EOT
    You are the shop assistant of Example Shop.
    Answer only from the shop's own pages and knowledge base.
    For order problems, ask for the order number and offer a support ticket.
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instructions` (String) The full instruction text. Surrounding white space is ignored.
- `website_id` (String) Id of the website, for example `asyntai_website.main.id`.

### Optional

- `allow_shrink` (Boolean) The API refuses a write that cuts the text to less than half of its current length, to protect against an empty or cut-off value. Set `true` to allow it. Defaults to `false`.
- `ask_questions` (Boolean) Let the agent ask the visitor short follow-up questions. Defaults to the current value of the website.
- `mode` (String) `instructions` (follow these rules) or `general` (general assistant). Defaults to the current mode of the website.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `website_id`.
- `version` (Number) Version number of the instructions. It goes up by one on each change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by website id.
terraform import asyntai_instructions.shop 42
```
